source: Neon canonical production branch — read-only SELECT via the Neon MCP (project hidden-mountain-87248164, branch br-crimson-frog-adr7g9gt), 2026-09-08
purpose: Production-state facts the coverage matrix cannot derive from code: what the stored rows actually carry today. No mutation was performed.

queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM listings) AS listings_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE address->>'Latitude' IS NOT NULL) AS address_latitude_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE raw_data->>'Latitude' IS NOT NULL) AS raw_latitude_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE raw_data->>'DaysOnMarket' IS NOT NULL) AS raw_dom_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE raw_data->>'MlsStatus' IS NOT NULL) AS raw_mlsstatus_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE raw_data->>'InternetEntireListingDisplayYN' IS NOT NULL) AS raw_ieldy_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM listing_search_projection) AS projection_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM listing_search_projection WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL) AS projection_latitude_present, (SELECT string_agg(column_name, ',' ORDER BY ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'listing_search_projection') AS projection_columns

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM listing_search_projection WHERE (feature_flags->>'has_virtual_tour') = 'true') AS projection_has_tour_true, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE raw_data ? 'VirtualTourURLUnbranded' AND raw_data->>'VirtualTourURLUnbranded' IS NOT NULL) AS raw_unbranded_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE raw_data->>'VirtualTourURLBranded' IS NOT NULL) AS raw_branded_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE raw_data->>'VirtualTourURLUnbranded2' IS NOT NULL) AS raw_unbranded2_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE raw_data ? 'VirtualTourURLBranded2') AS raw_branded2_key_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE raw_data->>'VideosCount' IS NOT NULL) AS raw_videoscount_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE status = 'Active') AS active_listings, (SELECT count(*) FROM listings WHERE raw_data IS NOT NULL AND raw_data::text <> '{}') AS raw_data_nonempty

readings: Coordinates: the provider suppresses Latitude/Longitude (null on all 591,597 live rows — suppressed census); the stored address container carries 0 of 26,510, the Search projection carries 0 of 26,510. The map has no provider coordinates and the geocoder (lib/geo/geocode.ts, scripts/batch-geocode.js) has backfilled none.

Tours: production stores VirtualTourURLUnbranded on 3,262 rows and VirtualTourURLBranded on 663, yet feature_flags.has_virtual_tour is true on 0 projection rows — the branch's has_virtual_tour derivation from the Property carriers is not deployed and the projection has not been backfilled. Unbranded2/3, Branded2/3 and VideosCount are absent from every stored raw_data (the keep-list additions are on this branch only).

Suppressed gates: InternetEntireListingDisplayYN is present in raw_data on 7 rows only (non-provider rows); the provider nulls it on every one of 591,597 rows. DaysOnMarket is stored nowhere (provider-suppressed); Mallan's DOM is computed, never read from the feed.
